independence: These arms began as a port but no longer depend on the tree they came from: the copier is deleted, no reference to its name remains, and CellFlow's checkpoint selection scores through our own cell-eval 0.6.0 rather than a sibling repo's scorer.
integrity_basis: This code's OWN baseline: one sha256 per vendored file, recorded so an unintended edit is visible. It is NOT a comparison against any other tree -- these four arms are independent code in this repository. Refresh a deliberate edit with scripts/refresh_competitor_manifest.py.
